correctness.rationale: 2-adic logarithmic and dilogarithmic cancellations hold by convergent power series and a derivable reflection identity. The cubic sum has unique minimal valuation −3 at j=4; the j-valuation trichotomy makes the dyadic comparison error valuation >=−1, hence the exact result follows for every m>=4. Independent recurrence and factorial-sum code agrees in all tested cases.

value.rationale: This answers a motivated exact divisibility question on the entire natural dyadic subsequence of a well-studied sequence; the 3m−2 extra 2-adic factors beyond factorial valuation require a double polylogarithmic cancellation and a nontrivial uniform error proof. It replaces coarse lower bounds by an exact infinite-family classification.
